skills.name: wechat-local-reader
skills.description: Turn a WeChat Official Account article link into a local Markdown document that agents can summarize, analyze, archive, or use for downstream tasks.
skills.scenario: Send a mp.weixin.qq.com link to an agent such as Codex, Hermes, or OpenClaw, and let the agent read the article locally and generate Markdown.
